text: At the side of the plaza, Leo noticed a friendly woman near the bench.

speaker: Aling Rosa
text: Good morning, dear! Are you Leo?

speaker: Aling Rosa
text: Ah! I knew it. You're the new kid in town, right?

speaker: Aling Rosa
text: Oh! My apologies, dear. I must be getting old!

speaker: Aling Rosa
text: Welcome to Luntian! So, do you know how to sign?

speaker: Aling Rosa
text: Oh? Then I must have heard the wrong story. My memory isn't what it used to be!
Aling Rosa laughed softly and returned to arranging the vegetables.

speaker: Aling Rosa
text: Oh, good! Then let me see. Do you understand me?

speaker: Aling Rosa
text: That's perfectly fine, dear. Everyone starts somewhere.

speaker: Aling Rosa
text: A little? That's already a good start! Keep practicing and you'll get better.

speaker: Aling Rosa
text: Wonderful! Oh, do you know Mira?

speaker: Aling Rosa
text: No worries! Maybe I'm signing too fast. What do you prefer?

speaker: Aling Rosa
text: Mira! That girl is always running around helping everyone.

speaker: Aling Rosa
text: You'll meet her soon enough. She seems to know everyone in Luntian!
Aling Rosa gave Leo a warm smile. Her friendly personality made him feel more at ease in Luntian.

speaker: Aling Rosa
text: Slow it is! Take your time, dear. There's no rush here.

speaker: Aling Rosa
text: Fast? Oh, look at you! Maybe you're more confident than you seem.
